name: Dr. Robert Sedgewick
bio: Professor of Computer Science at Princeton University and author of seminal textbooks on algorithms and data structures. His work has shaped computer science education worldwide.

name: Thomas H. Cormen
bio: Emeritus Professor at Dartmouth College and lead author of 'Introduction to Algorithms', the most widely used algorithms textbook globally.

name: Dr. Andrew S. Tanenbaum
bio: Professor at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam and creator of MINIX. Author of influential textbooks on operating systems and computer networks.

name: Martin Kleppmann
bio: Researcher at the University of Cambridge and author of 'Designing Data-Intensive Applications'. Expert in distributed systems and data engineering.

name: Dr. Abraham Silberschatz
bio: Professor at Yale University and renowned author of multiple textbooks on database systems and operating systems.

name: James F. Kurose
bio: Professor at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. Co-author of 'Computer Networking: A Top-Down Approach', a leading networking textbook.

name: William Stallings
bio: Prolific author of over 20 textbooks on computer security, networking, and cryptography used in universities worldwide.

name: Dr. Nitesh Dhanjani
bio: Cybersecurity expert and author specializing in cloud security, ethical hacking, and security architecture.

name: Dr. Niall Ó Broin
bio: Expert in cloud infrastructure and distributed systems. Author of comprehensive guides on cloud computing architecture and best practices.

name: Stuart Russell
bio: Professor of Computer Science at UC Berkeley and co-author of 'Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach', the standard AI textbook.

name: Christopher Bishop
bio: Distinguished scientist at Microsoft Research and author of 'Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning', a foundational ML text.

name: Ian Goodfellow
bio: Research scientist and lead author of 'Deep Learning' (the MIT Press book). Inventor of GANs (Generative Adversarial Networks).

name: Marijn Haverbeke
bio: Author of 'Eloquent JavaScript', one of the most popular programming books. Creator of the CodeMirror editor and TernJS.

name: David Flanagan
bio: Author of 'JavaScript: The Definitive Guide' and other programming references. Expert in web technologies and software development.

name: Miguel Grinberg
bio: Software engineer and author of the 'Flask Web Development' book. Creator of popular Flask tutorials and extensions.

name: Eric Freeman
bio: Computer scientist and co-author of multiple 'Head First' series books including 'Head First Design Patterns'. Expert in educational technology.

name: Bjarne Stroustrup
bio: Creator of the C++ programming language and author of 'The C++ Programming Language'. Professor at Columbia University.

name: Dr. Yuval Noah Harari
bio: Historian and author of 'Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind' and other bestselling works on human civilization.

name: Walter Isaacson
bio: Acclaimed biographer and journalist. Author of bestsellers including 'Steve Jobs', 'Einstein', and 'Leonardo da Vinci'.

name: James Clear
bio: Author of 'Atomic Habits', one of the most influential self-help books of the decade. Expert on habit formation and behavior change.

name: Cal Newport
bio: Professor at Georgetown University and author of books on focus, productivity, and deep work in the digital age.

name: Stephen Covey
bio: Author of 'The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People', one of the best-selling self-help books of all time.

name: Dr. Paul Deitel
bio: Co-author of the renowned 'Deitel & Deitel' programming textbooks series used by universities worldwide.

name: Bruce Eckel
bio: Author of 'Thinking in Java' and 'Thinking in C++', influential programming books that teach object-oriented thinking.

name: David Heinemeier Hansson
bio: Creator of Ruby on Rails and co-author of several books on web development and software design.

name: Zed Shaw
bio: Author of the 'Learn Code the Hard Way' series. Developer of Mongrel web server and Lamson project.

name: Steve McConnell
bio: Author of 'Code Complete', a seminal work on software construction. Expert in software engineering practices and project management.

name: Martin Fowler
bio: Chief Scientist at ThoughtWorks and author of influential books on refactoring, patterns, and software architecture.

name: Donald Knuth
bio: Professor Emeritus at Stanford University, creator of TeX, and author of 'The Art of Computer Programming' series.

name: Dr. Carlos Guestrin
bio: Professor at Stanford University and co-author of the 'Lazy Programmer' series on machine learning and AI.

name: Harold Abelson
bio: Professor at MIT and co-author of 'Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs', a classic CS text.

name: John Greenewald
bio: Expert in database systems and data warehousing. Author of comprehensive guides to modern database technologies.

name: Nathan Marz
bio: Creator of Apache Storm and author of 'Big Data: Principles and Practices'. Expert in scalable data processing.

name: Eben Upton
bio: Co-founder of the Raspberry Pi Foundation and author of guides on Raspberry Pi computing and IoT.

name: Kathy Sierra
bio: Co-author of 'Head First Java' and 'Head First Design Patterns'. Expert in educational technology and game design.

name: Peter Norvig
bio: Director of Research at Google and co-author of 'Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach'. Expert in AI and NLP.

name: Dr. Ngọc Nguyễn
bio: Professor of Computer Science and author of several textbooks on machine learning and data science.

name: Michael Nielsen
bio: Author of 'Neural Networks and Deep Learning'. Researcher in quantum computing and artificial intelligence.

name: Olivia Hawthorne
bio: Award-winning novelist and professor of creative writing. Author of critically acclaimed literary fiction.

name: Kevin Mitnick
bio: Legendary hacker turned security consultant. Author of 'The Art of Deception' and other cybersecurity books.
